appDescription: Finds a festival or local event the driver can still enjoy if they leave now, judging driving range, arrival time against event hours, and who is riding along.

function.name: SUGGEST_FESTIVAL_NOW
function.description: Recommend one festival or local event that is still open on arrival if the car leaves now.

timeBudgetMinutes.description: Free time the user has for the whole outing, in minutes.

returnByTime.description: Local time the user must be back home, in HH:mm 24-hour format.

withChildAge.description: Age of a child riding along, if the user mentions one.

withSenior.description: True if an elderly person is riding along.

withPet.description: True if a pet is riding along.

withStroller.description: True if the group needs stroller access.

withWheelchair.description: True if the group needs wheelchair access.

theme.description: Mood or type of event the user wants.

rainSafe.description: True if the event must be enjoyable in rain.

anotherOption.description: True if the user rejected the previous recommendation and wants a different one.

excludeContentIds.description: Content IDs of events already recommended and rejected in this conversation.

function.name: CHECK_FESTIVAL_ARRIVAL
function.description: Check whether a named festival or event will still be running when the car arrives if it leaves now, or answer a question about it such as its price, programs, parking, or facilities.

festivalName.description: Name of the festival or event the user asked about, taken from the conversation if the user says it or there.

question.description: The user's question about the festival in their own words, when they ask something other than whether it can still be seen.

function.name: START_FESTIVAL_ROUTE
function.description: Start navigation to the recommended or named festival, or plan the drive home after the event.

contentId.description: Content ID of the festival returned by a previous recommendation.

festivalName.description: Name of the festival when the target is named.
